c74object.name: mab.info
c74object.description: mab.info queries a TorchScript model in a separate Python worker and reports its metadata over five outlets: model path, available methods, attributes, per-method parameters and a dictionary containing the full inspection result. The query runs on a background thread; results are delivered on the Max main thread.

objarg.name: model
objarg.digest: Path to a TorchScript model file.
objarg.description: Absolute or package-relative path to a TorchScript (.ts) model. If omitted, use set path or path path to inspect a model.

method.name: set
method.digest: Set the model path and inspect it.
method.description: set path resolves the model path and starts a background query.

method.name: bang
method.description: If a model has already been inspected, output the cached result. Otherwise start a query if a model path is set.

method.name: dump
method.digest: Post full inspection to the Max console.
method.description: Prints model path, type, block size, channels, latent size, methods, attributes and per-method parameters. Also sends the data to the outlets.

method.name: path
method.digest: Set or get the model path.
method.description: With an argument, behaves like set path. Without an argument, outputs the current path from the first outlet.

method.name: methods
method.description: Sends a symbol list of the model's methods from the second outlet.

method.name: attributes
method.description: Sends a symbol list of the model's attributes from the third outlet.

method.name: parameters
method.description: With an optional method-name argument, outputs the parameters for that method (channels_in, ratio_in, channels_out, ratio_out) from the fourth outlet.

method.name: dict
method.digest: Register and output a named dictionary.
method.description: dict name registers the inspection result as a named dictionary and outputs it from the fifth outlet.

method.name: dump_dict
method.description: Sends the full inspection dictionary from the fifth outlet without registering it.
